Flagged physically implausible 2026-10-18 (m440, D55, D149): the sheet prints a heat deflection of 60 °C at 0.45 MPa beside its own tensile modulus of 50 MPa (V010402), for "a transparent thermoplastic elastomer based on cyclic olefin copolymers" with a Shore hardness of 89A. ISO 75 records the temperature at which the loaded bar bends a further 0.2 % of outer-fibre strain; the 0.45 MPa load alone strains a 50 MPa bar 0.9 %, and an 18 % fall of its modulus meets the criterion, so the number is not the softening of a rigid bar. HDT does not apply to an elastomer, and this one is filed under COC, where it would otherwise decide. Kept as printed; it backs nothing.

coverage.finding: Reviewed 2026-10-01: COC tough and COC flex (G137-01/G137-03) publish industrial, optical and medical/diagnostic application claims (Q04832/Q04833/Q04838/Q04839). The originals provide maker descriptions without application validation, medical/skin qualification or a tested finishing process. Tough and the declared softer flex variant remain distinct; no transfer of temperature, hardness or suitability follows. knowHow.text: COC Tough is a high-performance technical filament based on cyclo-olefin copolymer, specially developed for applications where mechanical strength, chemical resistance and optical neutrality are required.
The high temperature resistance makes the material ideally suited for industrial applications.
Through targeted impact taming modification, the material offers an extraordinary combination of robustness and thermal stability - ideal for functional components with demanding requirements.
COC tough is resistant to oils, alcohols, acids and many other chemicals.
This property makes the material particularly suitable for applications where elasticity and formal stability are required under changing climatic conditions.
At the same time, the transparency of the material is maintained – a crucial advantage for medical, diagnostic or optical products.
Due to the exceptionally low glass transition temperature below –90 °C, COC flex offers remarkable flexibility even at low temperatures.
outstanding transparency - high barrier against moisture - good chemical resistance
more difficult to print than TPU

polymer.basis: TOPAS cyclic olefin copolymer: "Because of its amorphous character" (product brochure, p. 6), with every basic grade at 1.02 g/cm3 to ISO 1183 (p. 7). TOPAS 8007S-04, an unfilled injection-moulding grade, gives the low end at 1010 kg/m3 and 0.01 % water at saturation to ISO 62, which is why the row records no water uptake. An amorphous polymer has no melting point.
